data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis from sibling c5fa, HIGH): The single migration-class/rollout emission dispatch point this task establishes MUST support INDEPENDENT marker evaluation — it is NOT a mutually-exclusive switch on one variable. migration-class (sweep|db|inconclusive, single-valued) and the separate feature-flags marker (added by sibling c5fa) are independent axes; a story that is both db AND flag-approved must be able to emit both pairs. Structure the dispatch point so sibling cases (db, flag-tag) are independent conditionals that compose, not a 'case $class' that drops one. Verify: grep -qiE 'independent|separately|in addition|compose' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
